Synopsis:
A player opens up Shirra Clarwen's crypt with the Sentient Amulet in tow. This will make the Mad Monk inside the amulet possess Shirra's body.

- WYR_SentientAmulet_Zombie.json: You have opened Shirra Clarwen’s crypt while carrying the Sentient Amulet that contains the Mad Monk’s spirit. Shirra is present as an empty, suffering husk (the monk calls her his granddaughter) and the spirit seeks to shed its “madness” onto a living vessel. The scene triggers a short cinematic in which the ghostly monk lunges out of the zombie body and the player is forced to contend with laughing madness and a potential Wisdom drain; the player can offer to take the curse or resist it, with dialogue and checks determining whether they hold their wits (and whether they gain effects like Tasha’s Hideous Laughter). context: You opened Shirra Clarwen’s crypt while carrying the Sentient Amulet, which contains the Mad Monk’s spirit; Shirra lies in the tomb as an empty, suffering husk the monk calls his granddaughter. Bringing the amulet here causes the monk’s astral self to leap from the corpse and attempt to cast his “madness” onto a living vessel. A short cinematic forces the player to choose whether to take the curse or resist, and the ghostly transfer can induce laughing madness and drain Wisdom. Dialogue choices and checks determine if you hold your wits (avoiding Wisdom loss or even gaining Tasha’s Hideous Laughter) or succumb to the monk’s mania; earlier contacts with the amulet have already hinted that it slowly drives wearers toward madness.
